text: The unconditional write puts revision 1 back. Source and cache now disagree.
Revision 1 is below the remembered 2. The atomic comparison rejects the card.
The unsafe rule compares revision 1 with an invented zero and accepts it. Losing knowledge has reopened the race.
The old card stops at the cache boundary. Absent does not match loading token A, so publication fails.
